profile.headline: AI Software Engineering Leader
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineering Manager with experience leading devops teams supporting high scale services and apps 24x7x365. 

Owner and founder of a software consulting company (JO-RO CONSULTING LLC). 
 
Experience working as a network engineer with a strong IT/Networking background.

Specialties: AI, ChatGPT, Copilot, ML, Azure, App Service, Certificates, Domains, DNS, MSI, ARM, AI, CI/CD, Logic Apps, Power Automate, Power Apps, Open API, OAuth2, Dynamics AX, C#, ERP Software, Business intelligence, Software integration, Web Services, C#, Networking

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working on Microsoft Azure backend services delivering highly reliable and performance services at scale.

Previously worked on Logic Apps, Power Platform leading connectors integration platform and earlier Dynamics 365 for Talent, Human Capital Management, Dynamics AX Accounting Framework
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Computer Science · Technical Services · Architecture · Building Trust · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Leveraging AI as a competitive advantage
Cloud/Hybrid Consulting
Premier Dynamics 365 Consultant 
General IT and Development consulting
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Computer Science · Technical Services · Building Trust

positions.title: Senior Microsoft Dynamics AX Development Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for customization, extension, and integration with Microsoft Dynamics AX in a multi-company and multi-currency deployment
Design and develop ERP integrations including with Data Masons Vantage Point EDI and Customs broker applications CANData and Descartes EDITrade
Design and develop a data warehouse and reporting tools for the business
Develop a build infrastructure and design development processes for the team
Lead and mentor other developers on the team
Manage relationship with MS Dynamics AX VAR
Customizing Microsoft Dynamics AX for the food and beverage industry in the financial and inventory modules.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Computer Science · Technical Services · Architecture · Building Trust

positions.title: Software Development Lead
positions.description:
Write and participate in functional specification documentation process
Define implementation plan including work item breakdown, time estimates and schedule
Design and document using UML models of complex systems
Development lead on large feature areas (Audit Policy, Budget Formulation, SourceDocument framework uptake, French Regulatory features)
Review and approve design documents and code
Work on code and unit tests for features
Manage developers and build engineers, including offshore development resources
Oversee and provide direction and policies for the Certified Public Sector solution code and environment of the next Dynamics AX version
Respected technical resource on the development team
Member of OLAP/BI v-team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research and planning using SAS as a data warehouse and business intelligence reporting platform including creating initial ETL (extract, transform, load) scripts, OLAP cubes, and BI reports
Design and coded web services to support integration with multiple content management systems (Tyler CM developed by another division, Laserfiche) and wrote a framework for extension to other systems in the future
Performed initial research and analysis on new technologies and their potential impact or use in the MUNIS ERP application.
Report findings to management and provide transition documentation to developers 
Work with a variety of operating systems and databases including multiple versions of UNIX, Linux, Windows, SQL, Oracle, and Informix
Created web service interface allowing MUNIS ERP software to achieve SIF certification

positions.title: IT Help Center - Student Manager
positions.description:
Managed support team for 10,000+ faculty, students, and staff
Network, software, and hardware consulting, troubleshooting, and repair

Wrote pGina open source plugin to authenticate windows logons against a POP3 server for lab computers
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Technical Services

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
Specialized in enterprise level solutions for networking, security, and software/hardware decisions
Designed and implemented complex local and wide area networks

Developed database-driven website in PHP/MySQL for customers to submit work tickets
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Technical Services · Architecture

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description:
Performed server and network administration
Developed a server disaster recovery plan for 22 production servers
Updated the IT standard operating procedures in Lotus Notes database entries
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Reliability · Programming · Technical Services
